title: RiskProfileReadOnly
description:
Serializes read-only fields for risk profiles.

ViewSet: RiskProfileViewSet

Endpoint: GET /risk-profiles/

type.description: Type of risk profile. Base represents a base question set with a line of business. Monoline represents a carrier question set with a product and route configuration. Package represents a carrier question set with a product, route configuration, and related risk profile children. Bundle represents a carrier question set with a market and related risk profile children.

version.description: Version number for a risk profile. A newly created risk profile's version is null, and will be set automatically when the risk profile is locked. The version number starts at 1 and increments by 1 based on existing risk profiles with matching market, line of business, product, route, and children.

isAvailable.description: Indicates whether the risk profile has no issues after testing and is available to quote from. Set this via admin action on the list page (subject to permission).

isLatest.description: Indicates whether this risk profile is the latest version. For bookkeeping purposes only - not used for business logic.Set this via admin action on the list page (subject to permission).

MarketSimple.description:
Serializes subset of read-only fields for Market.

ViewSet: RiskProfileViewSet

Endpoint: GET /risk-profiles/

ProductReadOnly.description:
Serializes subset of read-only fields for Product.

ViewSet: RiskProfileViewSet

Endpoint: GET /risk-profiles/

RouteConfigurationReadOnly.description:
Serializes subset of read-only fields for RouteConfiguration.

ViewSet: RiskProfileViewSet

Endpoint: GET /risk-profiles/
